<!-- WARNING: knitr RUNS chunks and inline code even inside an HTML comment
     like this one. Use #| eval: false to disable one. -->
<!-- One table = one chunk with a tbl-* label and its legend in #| tbl-cap.
     Cite it from the text with @tbl-models.
     Quarto writes the caption: do NOT also use flextable::set_caption() or it
     will be duplicated. -->

```{r}
#| label: tbl-models
#| include: true
#| tbl-cap: "Legend of table 1."
# flextable for formatted tables (bold, grouping, footnotes).
tab <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("Treatment", "Altitude"),
  Estimate = c(0.42, -0.13),
  SE       = c(0.11, 0.05),
  p        = c(0.0002, 0.0141)
)
tab$p <- paste0(format.pval(tab$p, digits = 2), stars_pval(tab$p))
fit_flextable_to_page(flextable::flextable(tab))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary
#| include: true
#| tbl-cap: "Legend of table 2."
# knitr::kable() is enough for simple tables and travels better across formats.
knitr::kable(head(iris, 3))
```
